# Care instructions

## Jackets
Wash waterproof jackets at 30 degrees with a mild detergent and no fabric softener. Tumble dry on low heat to reactivate the water-repellent finish.
Down jackets: wash with special down detergent and dry with two tennis balls in the dryer so the down does not clump.

## Shoes
Remove dirt with a soft brush and lukewarm water. Do not machine wash shoes and do not dry them on a radiator.
Stuff wet shoes with newspaper and let them dry at room temperature.

## Merino socks
Machine wash at 30 degrees, inside out. Do not tumble dry.
